subject.title: feat: add publisher following and activity timeline

question: Should ClawHub intentionally make a user’s publisher-follow relationships publicly discoverable through follower and following endpoints, while also storing durable followed-publisher activity?
rationale: The implementation creates a new public identity and privacy surface, not merely a UI enhancement; source review can verify guards but cannot choose the permanent social-discovery policy.

options.title: Approve the public discovery model
options.body: Accept public publisher-identity follower/following lists and the pull-based activity timeline, subject to dependency integration and live proof.

options.title: Keep follows private
options.body: Retain authenticated personal following and discovery but remove or redesign public social-graph endpoints before merge.

options.title: Defer social discovery
options.body: Pause the feature until ClawHub has a broader product decision for publisher social signals and retention.

recommendation.title: Approve the public discovery model
recommendation.body: Accept public publisher-identity follower/following lists and the pull-based activity timeline, subject to dependency integration and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies this collaborator as the reviewer who established the adjacent release-visibility and scheduling boundary.
